skill.name: set-up-lightspeed-google-ads-conversion-tracking
skill.description: Set up or troubleshoot server-side Google Ads purchase tracking for Lightspeed eCom (C-Series) through Product Metrics. Connect the store, configure consent, and verify that a paid test order reaches the linked property.
skill.summary: Configure and test consent-based Lightspeed purchase tracking for Google Ads.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most static matches are documentation, setup checks, or ordinary account configuration. The order lookup lacks output safeguards, and the installation example runs unpinned tooling. The workflow also permits command-line credential handling and does not consistently require approval for account changes or unrelated features.

remediation.issue: The agent can collect and pass API credentials to a command.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the exception for agent-handled credentials. Direct administrators to the verified Product Metrics app and have the agent read only the resulting connection status.

remediation.issue: Order lookups return raw results without a test-only or redaction requirement.
remediation.suggestion: Require approval for the specific test order and use a response limited to delivery status. Keep raw order records out of agent transcripts.

remediation.issue: The workflow does not require separate approval for agent writes.
remediation.suggestion: Show the affected workspace, store, destination, and permissions before each group of changes. Obtain explicit approval and verify consent before forwarding live orders.

remediation.issue: Linked setup guides include steps outside basic Google Ads conversion tracking.
remediation.suggestion: Specify which reference steps apply. Skip other ad channels, Enhanced Conversions, and Customer Match unless separately requested and approved.

remediation.issue: The installation example runs an unpinned package and selects a floating skill source.
remediation.suggestion: Document a verified installer version and immutable skill revision. Require operator confirmation before installation.

content.user_title: Set Up Lightspeed Conversion Tracking for Google Ads
content.value_statement: Browser tracking can miss purchases, making Lightspeed orders and Google Ads reports hard to reconcile. Use Product Metrics to configure server-side tracking and verify a paid test order.
actual_capabilities: Read Product Metrics setup status and identify incomplete steps for a specific store and Google Ads property.
Guide an administrator through the Lightspeed connection and the Cloudflare tracking gateway setup.
Guide selection of the Google Ads client account and explain Merchant Center and Data Manager requirements.
Check whether the configured consent banner matches the banner shown on the storefront.
Guide creation of eight secondary conversion actions and explain the costs needed for profit reporting.
Explain how to verify a paid test order and troubleshoot missing conversions.
limitations: Requires Lightspeed eCom C-Series in Europe or the United States, Product Metrics Pro, and a storefront domain proxied through Cloudflare.
An authorized person must complete sign-ins and approvals in the relevant account. The user also decides whether to make a conversion action primary.
Only eligible paid orders are sent. Consent and Google Ads attribution can keep reported conversions below total store orders.
Does not configure Enhanced Conversions, Customer Match, or bidding.

use_cases.title: Plan a first installation
use_cases.description: Identify the accounts, permissions, and store details needed before setting up tracking.

use_cases.title: Review conversion actions before changing bidding
use_cases.description: Confirm that the new actions are secondary and compare them with existing purchase tracking.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a missing test purchase
use_cases.description: Check store publication, property linkage, payment status, and consent before changing configuration.

prompt_templates.title: Check prerequisites
prompt_templates.prompt: List what I need to set up Google Ads purchase tracking for my Lightspeed C-Series store. Give me a checklist only.

prompt_templates.title: Find the next setup step
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the setup status for my selected Product Metrics store and Google Ads property. Tell me what is complete and what requires my approval. Do not make changes.

prompt_templates.title: Review consent and conversion actions
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me verify that the configured consent banner matches my storefront and that all new conversion actions are secondary. Do not change settings or request credentials.

prompt_templates.title: Trace a missing conversion
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me diagnose why an approved paid test order has not appeared for the linked Google Ads property. Report delivery status only. Do not list other orders, expose customer details, or change settings.

output_examples.input: The Lightspeed connection is active, but publication is still pending. What should I do next?
output: Reopen Manage Lightspeed and check whether publication reads Configuration is current.
Once publication is current, confirm the intended Google Ads property before linking the store.

output_examples.input: My pay-on-pickup test order was placed but has not been paid. Should it appear as a conversion?
output: No. Lightspeed must mark the order as paid before Product Metrics can send it.
After payment, check the configured consent banner and confirm the test order reaches the linked property.

best_practices: Enter credentials only in the verified Product Metrics app, not in chat or agent commands.
Confirm the selected store, Google Ads client account, and storefront consent settings before approving changes.
Keep new actions secondary while validating tracking with an approved paid test order.
anti_patterns: Connecting a Google Ads manager account instead of the client account that runs the campaigns.
Expecting unpaid orders or orders without the required consent to appear as conversions.
Making both revenue and profit purchase actions primary and counting the same purchase twice.

faq.question: Which Lightspeed stores are supported?
faq.answer: The guide covers Lightspeed eCom C-Series stores on the Europe or United States cluster.

faq.question: Do I need a paid Product Metrics plan?
faq.answer: Yes. The guide lists Product Metrics Pro as a requirement and includes server-side tracking in that plan.

faq.question: Why is Cloudflare required?
faq.answer: A Cloudflare Worker serves the tracking script and event collector on the shop domain because Lightspeed eCom has no app proxy.

faq.question: Do I need Google Merchant Center?
faq.answer: Yes. Link Merchant Center to your Google Ads client account in Google, then connect it in Product Metrics.

faq.question: Will setup change what my campaigns optimize for?
faq.answer: No. The new conversion actions start as secondary. A person must choose whether to make one primary in Google Ads.

faq.question: What happens when a purchase is refunded?
faq.answer: Lightspeed credit notes are handled as refunds. Product Metrics adjusts the corresponding Google Ads conversion.
